policy: Use game scene/timeline labels as identity evidence, then narrow physical candidates by matching set/story context. If the physical catalog lacks that game-specific state, preserve the digital variant instead of backfilling an approximate release.

records.reason: The Tatooine suffix is an explicit game appearance state. The 1999 Padmé candidate occurs in Anakin's Podracer and Mos Espa Podrace, giving independent Tatooine/Mos Espa set context that strongly supports the same appearance family; exact model/print equivalence remains visual pending.

The game explicitly names Old - Ahch-To, and the leading physical candidate is an old Luke released in Ahch-To Island Training. Character, age/state, and scene context agree; exact print/component reuse remains visual pending.
